description: This file defines a static class 'RuntimeContext' that manages the current grain context within the Orleans runtime, utilizing thread-local storage.

classes.name: RuntimeContext
classes.description: A static class providing functionality to manage the current grain context in Orleans, including setting and resetting the context using thread-local storage.

methods.name: SetExecutionContext
methods.description: Sets the current grain context to a new context and outputs the previous context.

methods.name: ResetExecutionContext
methods.description: Resets the current grain context to the specified original context.
